arabic text:
MERA GHAR JALAYA LUTIYAN RIDAWAN
RO AKAY ZAINAB KIS PAS JAWAN.
ABID BACHAWAN, YA AGH BUJHAWAN
RO AKAY ZAINAB KIS PAS JAWAN.
english translation text:
They burned my home and stole our veils.
Weeping, to whom can Zainab turn?
Should I save Abid, or put out the fire?
Weeping, to whom can Zainab turn?

arabic text:
YUSAF TOUN SONAY MERE VEER MAAREY,
MEH SHAAM CHALIYAN BAYKAFAN SAAREY
KABARAN BANAWAN, YA RASIYAN PAWAN
RO AKAY ZAINAB KIS PAS JAWAN.
english translation text:
My brothers, more beautiful than Yusuf, have been killed.
I am being taken to Shaam, while all lie without shrouds.
Should I prepare their graves, or submit to these ropes?
Weeping, to whom can Zainab turn?

arabic text:
MEH DEEN BACHAWAN VICH SHAAM AAYI,
SAB LOUG VEIKAN MERI BAYRIDAYEE
KHUTBAY SUNAWAN, YA MOU LUKAAWAN
RO AKAY ZAINAB KIS PAS JAWAN.
english translation text:
I came to Shaam to preserve the faith,
while crowds stare at me without a veil.
Should I deliver the sermons, or hide my face?
Weeping, to whom can Zainab turn?

arabic text:
JIS VEER DAY LAIYE CHADEYA MADINA,
JIWAY QATAL HOYA BHULNA KADEENA
HUN KAFAN PAWAN, YA SHAAM JAWAN
RO AKEY ZAINAB KIS PAS JAWAN.
english translation text:
For the brother for whom I left Madina—
I can never forget how he was killed.
Should I place a shroud upon him, or depart for Shaam?
Weeping, to whom can Zainab turn?

arabic text:
KHAIMEY’CH QASIM DI LAASH AAYI,
CHUM CHUM KAY TUKRAY KAVEY ZAHRA JAYEE
HUN SEHRAY LAVANM YA SAF VICHAWAN
RO AKAY ZAINAB KIS PAS JAWAN.
english translation text:
Qasim’s body was brought into the tent.
Kissing each piece, Zahra’s daughter cried:
Should I adorn him with his wedding crown, or spread the funeral sheet?
Weeping, to whom can Zainab turn?
